verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was to me, “Behold.”
verses.2: The son of Adam had two daughters from the daughter of one of his brothers.
verses.3: And they were captured in Egypt. Their children were taken captive, and their women were raped. There, they were forced to weave cloth.
verses.4: And their names were the Great Temple and its sister temple. They became my wives, and they gave birth to sons and daughters. And their names were those who guarded the Temple, and Jerusalem, its sister temple.
verses.5: And she destroyed my tent, and she grieved over her lovers who were near Ashur.
verses.6: To those who are covered with filth and dirt, and who live in places of filth, all of them are like riders on horses.
verses.7: And she gave her gifts to them, chosen from among the sons of Ashur. All those who were worthy were buried with her.
verses.8: And she did not abandon her treasures from Egypt. They remained in her treasures, and those who were there made offerings to her. They poured their treasures upon her.
verses.9: Therefore, she was given into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the sons of Ashur, who were angry with her.
verses.10: Her wickedness was revealed through her children and their children. They took her away, and she was killed on the mountain. Then she became a source of shame for women and men.
verses.11: And her sister Ahloibah saw her, and she was disgusted by her appearance. She also disdained her beauty.
verses.12: To the sons of Ashur: they are like sheep that are led by their shepherds. They are like riders on horses, in the fields of Hamed. All of them.
verses.13: And I saw that they were buried in one place.
verses.14: And she joined her hands together. She saw people of Makhukhah on the walls, with pictures of devils carved into them.
verses.15: The cages of Ezer, with their decorations, have on their heads beautiful decorations. They all look like the sons of Babylon, like those who were born in this land.
verses.16: And she became angry at them, and her eyes became filled with anger. She sent her servants after them as enemies.
verses.17: And the sons of Babylon came to her to be buried with their fathers. They covered her body with their clothes, and her soul was trapped within them.
verses.18: And her wickedness became apparent, and her evil nature was revealed. My soul was broken from within her, just as my soul was broken from within my sister.
verses.19: And she bent her knees, in memory of the days of her youth, when she was a virgin in the land of Egypt.
verses.20: And she became angry at their arrogance, which was evident in their words and actions. The flow of horses also became turbulent.
verses.21: I have attended to the needs of your young men during their time in Egypt, so that their lives may be saved.
verses.22: Therefore, O Ahlohiba, I say this: “Lord Jehovah, I am from your city. I come to you with those who have been wounded in their hearts by them. Bring them back to you from the surrounding areas.”
verses.23: The sons of Babylon and all their enemies were destroyed. All the children of Ashur also were destroyed. They were killed in the battles at Hamd-Fakhoat and Sagan. In total, there were thirty-six people who were killed in those battles. They were all riders on horses.
verses.24: And a chariot and wheels came upon you. And in the midst of nations, there were armies of soldiers and guards who surrounded you. I would judge them according to their own laws, and they would judge you according to their own laws.
verses.25: And I will give you jealousy as a gift. They will burn you with fire. Your ears will be torn off, and your hair will fall out. Your children and your daughters will be taken away. And your hair will be eaten by the fire.
verses.26: And they shall take off your clothes, and take away all your ornaments.
verses.27: And I will take away your slavery from you, and your oppression from the land of Egypt. Do not look at them again, and do not remember Egypt anymore.
verses.28: For as the Lord God said, “I will give you to those who hate you, those whose hearts are filled with hatred against you.”
verses.29: And they treated you with hatred. They took everything that belonged to you, and left you behind in a city where people were cruel and vicious. Your shame and your disgrace became known everywhere.
verses.30: He made these things for you in your own time, after the nations who were destroyed in their wars.
verses.31: In your path, you walked; and I gave you a bag in your hands.
verses.32: Thus said Adonai Jehovah: Your sister will become a place of laughter and joy. It will be a source of amusement and delight for everyone.
verses.33: Shikaron and Yagon will fill your chests with treasures. Your chests will be filled with wealth and prosperity.
verses.34: And I will set her ablaze, and her branches will be destroyed. I will also cut off her branches from the ground. For I have spoken these words, O LORD God.
verses.35: Therefore, this is what the Lord God said: “You have forgotten me, and you have cast me aside after your own will. And you also will be punished for your actions.”
verses.36: And the LORD said to Adam, “You shall build an altar and a sanctuary for Me. Then you shall tell them about their sins.”
verses.37: For their wounds were bloody, and their bodies were covered in blood. Also, all their children who were born to me were taken away from them, so that they could be given to others as food.
verses.38: And on that day, they also covered my sacred places with dirt, and they desecrated my holy sites.
verses.39: And they slaughtered their children as sacrifices. On that day, they went to my temple to destroy it. And behold, this is what they did inside my house.
verses.40: And even though you send them to people who come from far away, when a messenger is sent to them. And behold, they come, just as your eyes have seen it.
verses.41: And you shall sit upon a sturdy chair, with a table in front of you. And I will place my offerings and gifts upon it.
verses.42: And the sound of the men’s laughter can be heard there. Many people from the desert come there. They put on beautiful clothes and adornments on their heads.
verses.43: And he said to Balah, “Now they will be punished. They will suffer for their actions.”
verses.44: And he came to her, just as one would go to a beautiful woman. So they went into the tent and into the room of Aholia, the wife of Zimah.
verses.45: And many righteous people will judge them according to unjust laws and laws that lead to bloodshed. For they have now shed blood, and their hands are stained with blood.
verses.46: For so said Adonai YHWH: He will raise up a crowd against them, and they will be destroyed and scattered.
verses.47: And they covered them with stones. In their destruction, they were killed by their own children and their daughters. And in their homes, they were burned to death.
verses.48: And my time had come from the earth. All the women were removed from there, and we would not do as you command.
verses.49: And we will give you forgiveness for your sins. And know that I, Jehovah, am your Savior.
